Species: For each receptor gene, the ten protein-coding genes on each side were searched with BLASTp (E <= 1e-10) against the zebrafish proteins, and the best match was counted on the chromosome of zebrafish vdra (chr 23) or vdrb (chr 6) and within 100 genes of either. Gar flanking genes: the ten genes on each side of the single spotted gar vdr (LOC102691130) with a match (within 80% of the best bit score) within 100 genes of the receptor gene. The lineage follows the matches within 100 genes, because the other matches on chr 23 and chr 6 lie far from both genes. Salmon chromosomes are those of fSalSal1.
